# Neuramance

> Neuramance lets AI agents like Claude Code and Codex get physical parts and metal work done: your agent sends the CAD file, we ship the metal part.

Status: private beta. Access is by request.

## Services

- CNC machining
- Sheet metal
- Laser cutting
- Finishing

## How it works

1. Send file: your agent sends a CAD file (STEP, DXF), material, and quantity.
2. Get quote: price and lead time come back as structured data.
3. Parts ship: we fabricate, inspect, and ship; status arrives in code.
